document.title: Share path and file helpers in a util module
document.summary: Duplicated C helpers move into `src/core/util.{c,h}` with `vd_` names, the file readers fail on `fseek`/`ftell`/short `fread` errors, and a few small cleanups land beside it: one free path in `instance_tree.c`, one screen-size constant, registry static asserts, and dead code removal.
document.why: The helpers were [copied across seven files and the copies already differ](source:s1), and the `read_file` variants [ignore `fseek` / `ftell` failures](source:s1).

sources.title: [Claude] Deduplicate C helpers into a util module
sources.gist: Move set_error, join_path, has_suffix, is_dir, mkdir_p, read_text_file, remove_tree, safe_package_name into one util module with checked file reads; one screen-size constant; static asserts; delete dead code.

lookFor: The ticket lists [`package_library_root`](source:s1) as dead code; it does not exist on `main` at the base, so nothing is deleted for it.
`path_exists` stays a static in `package_manifest.c` because it has one caller; the ticket does not name it.

groups.title: util module and caller switch
groups.why: Gives every module [one copy of each helper](source:s1) instead of diverging static copies.
groups.summary: `src/core/util.c` defines the `vd_` helpers once, and every former owner, including `package_manifest_harness`, deletes its static copy and calls the shared one.
lookFor: Subtle: `vd_safe_package_name` keeps the `VD_PACKAGE_NAME_MAX` length check that only `package_manifest.c` had, so `package_library_remove` now rejects a 128-character `.vdapp` name it used to accept.

Subtle: `vd_join_path` is `snprintf` with a checked return; on overflow it writes a truncated, terminated path and returns false, where `package_manifest.c`'s old copy left `out` untouched. Callers that ignore the result behave as before.

groups.title: Checked file reads
groups.why: The old readers [malloc `len + 1` with a possibly negative `len`](source:s1).
groups.summary: `vd_read_file` fails on any `fseek`, `ftell`, or short `fread` error, and `jslib.c` and `js_runtime.c` replace their unchecked readers with it, while `archive.c`'s arena reader gets the same `fseek` checks.
lookFor: A file that shrinks between `ftell` and `fread` now returns NULL instead of a partial, NUL-terminated buffer; `nativeReadTextFile` throws "Could not read file" for it.
`vd_mkdir_p` and `vd_mkdir_parent` return false for a path of 512+ bytes instead of creating a truncated directory.

groups.title: Publish rejects an over-long backup path
groups.why: GCC flagged `-Wformat-truncation` on the `.replacing` `snprintf`; a truncated backup path would be passed to `vd_remove_tree`.
groups.summary: `package_library_publish_package` checks the `snprintf` result for `<destination>.replacing` and fails with "Deck App Package path is too long." before touching the disk.

groups.title: One instance free body
groups.summary: `free_instance_tree` frees the children recursively and then calls `instance_back_free` for the node itself.

groups.title: One screen-size constant
groups.summary: `shell.c` includes `core/bootstrap.h` and uses `VD_SCREEN_WIDTH`/`VD_SCREEN_HEIGHT` in place of its own copies.

groups.title: Registry capacity asserts
groups.why: The font and image registries index by manifest asset count, so they must be [tied to `VD_PACKAGE_*_MAX`](source:s1).
groups.summary: `_Static_assert`s in `fonts.c` and `images.c` fail the build if `VD_FONT_MAX` or `VD_IMAGE_MAX` drops below the manifest limit.

groups.title: Dead code
groups.why: The ticket lists these as [dead code to delete](source:s1).
groups.summary: `EVT_SHUTDOWN`, `js_runtime_restart`, `VdShell.bind_error`, and the FPS counter and touch circles in `main.c` go away with their only writers.
lookFor: The host and Vita windows no longer show the FPS counter in the top right or red circles under touches; neither was behind a debug flag, and `smoke_harness` never drew them, so the golden is unaffected.

commits.subject: refactor: delete dead code
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
EVT_SHUTDOWN was never pushed, js_runtime_restart had no callers, shell->bind_error was written but never drawn, and main.c drew an FPS counter and red touch circles over every frame outside any debug flag.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: fix(core): fail file reads on fseek, ftell or short fread errors
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
jslib.c and js_runtime.c had unchecked readers that malloc'd len + 1 from an unchecked ftell; they now share vd_read_file. mkdir_p and mkdir_parent reject over-long paths instead of truncating them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: refactor(core): move duplicated path and file helpers into util module
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Keeps the strictest copies: the package name length check from package_manifest.c and a join_path that reports truncation.
